# Style Reference Index

| Direction | Reference | Best fit |
|---|---|---|
| Editorial | `styles/editorial.md` | narrative, publishing, content-led products |
| Swiss Minimal | `styles/swiss-minimal.md` | rigorous grids and neutral hierarchy |
| Minimal Corporate | `styles/minimal-corporate.md` | restrained B2B and operations tools |
| Bento Grid | `styles/bento-grid.md` | modular dashboards and feature overviews |
| Dark Mode First | `styles/dark-mode-first.md` | technical, media, or low-light products |
| Neobrutalism | `styles/neobrutalism.md` | bold consumer or experimental interfaces |
| Liquid Glass | `styles/liquid-glass.md` | depth-rich platform surfaces used sparingly |
| Terminal/Hacker | `styles/terminal-hacker.md` | developer and security tools |
| Retro Pixel | `styles/retro-pixel.md` | playful, game-like, nostalgic products |
| WIGTN Brand | `../../wigtn-presentation/references/brand.md` | explicit WIGTN identity |

`Brutalist` and generic `Minimalism` are intentionally excluded: Neobrutalism and the two specific minimal directions provide clearer implementation contracts with less overlap.
